bulwark_slam.name: Bulwark Slam
bulwark_slam.description: Slam the target with your shield.

ironhide.name: Ironhide
ironhide.description: Reduce damage taken by 60% for 8 sec.

challenging_roar.name: Challenging Roar
challenging_roar.description: Force all nearby enemies to attack you.

radiant_hymn.name: Radiant Hymn
radiant_hymn.description: Heal the entire party for a large amount.

sunspark.name: Sunspark
sunspark.description: Hurl a mote of light at an enemy.

fan_of_blades.name: Scatterblades
fan_of_blades.description: Throw blades at all nearby enemies.

piercing_shot.name: Piercing Shot
piercing_shot.description: A powerful shot that punches through armor.

wild_roar.name: Wild Roar
wild_roar.description: Increase the party's haste by 30% for 30 sec.

soul_rend.name: Soul Rend
soul_rend.description: Tank buster. Massive damage plus a lingering wound. Use a defensive!

requiem_of_bones.name: Requiem of Bones
requiem_of_bones.description: Damages the whole party. INTERRUPT IT.

desecrate.name: Desecrate
desecrate.description: Corrupts the ground beneath three players. Move out!

hollow_fury.name: Hollow Fury
hollow_fury.description: Enraged: shadow damage to the whole party every second, growing each time.

raise_dead.name: Summon the Restless
raise_dead.description: Summons Bonewalkers from the crypt doors. Kill them!

grave_volley.name: Grave Volley
grave_volley.description: A volley of bone shards hits the whole party. Interrupt it.

mend_bones.name: Mend Bones
mend_bones.description: Restores 30% health to the most injured undead ally. Interrupt it, or kill the Mender first.

bone_bolt.name: Bone Bolt
bone_bolt.description: A ranged bolt at the caster's target.

restless_grave.name: Restless Grave
restless_grave.description: When an undead enemy other than Oruth dies, it leaves a Restless Grave on the ground for 12 sec. The grave heals other undead standing in it by 5% of their health every second, and hurts players standing in it. Fight enemies away from graves.

grave_mark.name: Grave Mark
grave_mark.description: Brands a player; after 6 sec it detonates on everyone within 6 m. Spread out.

marrow_shards.name: Marrow Shards
marrow_shards.description: Bone shards from a fallen undead: damage every second, per stack.

grave_mark.name: Grave Mark
grave_mark.description: Detonates when it expires, hitting every ally within 6 m hard. Get away from the group.

restless_graves.name: Restless Graves
restless_graves.description: When an undead enemy other than Oruth dies, it leaves a Restless Grave on the ground for 12 sec. The grave heals other undead standing in it by 5% of their health every second, and hurts players standing in it. Fight enemies away from graves.

marrowburst.name: Marrowburst
marrowburst.description: When an undead enemy other than Oruth dies, every player gains a stack of Marrow Shards: shadow damage every second for 4 sec, for each stack. Many kills at once stack it high: stagger kills.

hollow_tyrant.name: Hollow Tyrant
hollow_tyrant.description: Oruth Summons the Restless three times (at 80%, 50% and 25% health), Desecrates four players instead of three, and every ~24 sec brands a player with a Grave Mark: after 6 sec it detonates, hitting the marked player and, much harder, every ally within 6 m of them. Spread out.
